summary: 1time allows you to share passwords, API keys, and files securely via self-destructing links. Data is encrypted client-side in the browser so that plaintext secrets never reach the server, and links expire automatically after a set number of views.
goodFor: Teams and individuals who need to transmit sensitive credentials or small files securely without relying on third-party SaaS platforms.
watchOut: The project has a modest GitHub star count and slowing maintenance activity, meaning you may need to patch bugs yourself if the upstream project stalls.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and ensure any necessary persistent storage volumes are mapped correctly.
